Features​
Large medieval castle overlooking the village
Multiple detailed houses and towers
Dense custom forest environment
Detailed paths, gardens and vegetation
Waterfalls and rocky terrain
Farms and decorative areas

name: Medieval Mountain Village
description: Discover a detailed Medieval Mountain Village, built around an imposing castle overlooking a dense pine forest.
